A simple two-row chart titled "Negative adverb pairs". Row 1: a green box "No sooner" connected by an arrow to a green box "than", with a small note "sooner is a comparative → than". Row 2: two blue boxes "Hardly" and "Scarcely" connected by arrows to a blue box "when", with a small note "never 'than'". Beneath, an example strip: "No sooner had the bell rung than the students rushed out." and "Hardly had we sat down when the light went off." with the auxiliary "had" highlighted before the subject to show inversion.
